reason: Zero errors in 26624 bits bounds the BER only at 1.44e-4 (95% Wilson upper; exact zero-count bound 1.13e-4), which still contains the 1e-4 target while just 2.66 errors would be expected under it, so the run has no power to certify the target, and the theoretical QPSK prediction 4.91e-5 (1.31 expected errors) is also within counting noise at z = -1.14, so the measurement neither supports nor refutes the 1e-4 claim - about 29956 error-free bits would be needed to certify it.
